items.name: Ryzen 9 9900X
items.note: 12 cores: strong for work (rendering, code, video); in games behind the X3D chips, which is why the builder does not pick it for gaming.

items.name: Ryzen 7 9850X3D
items.note: The fastest gaming CPU: about 3-5 % ahead of the 9800X3D, but about 30 % more power for it. Launch price €499, about €460 in shops.

items.note: 3D cache on both halves (192 MB): for big simulations and code builds; in games barely ahead of the 9950X3D.

items.name: Ryzen 9 9900X3D
items.note: Cache on one 6-core half only: games run on 6 fast cores, so the 8-core X3D chips are better for pure gaming.

items.name: Ryzen 5 7500F
items.note: No integrated graphics: needs a graphics card. The cheapest way onto AM5.

items.name: Ryzen 7 8700G
items.note: Strong integrated graphics: light gaming without a graphics card.
